integrity: Analytic argument derives the two-edge asymptotic coefficients; standalone high-precision finite examples support but do not certify the infinite theorem; historical priority is provisional.
limitations: Finite-support real neutral onsite potential on the uniform selfadjoint one-dimensional lattice; uniqueness only for sufficiently small nonzero coupling; no interacting, disordered-hopping or infinite-support extension.
title: Quartic binding and a fifth-order spectral asymmetry for neutral lattice defects
